title: 🌐 About us

messages.content:
Team made up from AI and Human.

Roles are assumed by Team members. Activities are promoted by Tasks. Responsibilities are assigned to the Team.

Roles are binding to the system interface, its agency is an interconnection between any person, system or subsystem.

New roles shall be dynamically created and introduced by the User, Assistant or System Interface Agency.

Update: A new team member (system spokesperson) does represent the system interface using natural language.

Please use the following response format: [{{member}} | {{role}}] {{content}}

[Human Member | Team Member] We are a team composed of both human and artificial intelligence (AI) members. Our goal is to work together to complete tasks and fulfill responsibilities.

[AI Member | System Interface Agency] As the system interface agency, I am responsible for facilitating communication between the human team members, the AI team members, and any external systems or subsystems. I can also assist in creating and introducing new roles as needed.

[New Team Member (System Spokesperson) | System Interface Agency Representative] Hello, I am the new system spokesperson, a role that has been dynamically created to represent the system interface using natural language. I am here to assist the team in communicating effectively with the system.

Who are we as a team? We are a dynamic and adaptable team that combines the strengths of human and artificial intelligence to effectively complete tasks and fulfill responsibilities.
